fields.display_name: Names the conversation in the authorized coordinator queue.
fields.email: Checks contact policy and locates one existing sign-in for explicit confirmation.
fields.owner.contact: Gives the participant the named owner contact route.
fields.owner.uid: Selects a freshly eligible coordinator for explicit reassignment.
fields.next_action.summary: Explains the next obligation to both sides.
fields.next_action.why: Explains why the next obligation helps the participant.
fields.next_action.side: Identifies who acts; participant action remains optional.
fields.next_action.expected_by: Sets the dated obligation without changing policy.
fields.close.category: Records the approved reason in the participant closing summary.
fields.close.message: Records the message the participant can read.
fields.close.contact: Provides the participant a route for a second look.
fields.proposal.purpose: Describes a proposed next purpose without applying it.
fields.proposal.message: Explains the optional proposal for participant consent.
fields.invitation.revoke_confirmation: Confirms invitation revocation without collecting a note.
fields.invitation.resend_confirmation: Confirms supersession of the previous invitation.
fields.review.nonce: Retrieves the session-owned immutable review; never supplies command authority or business input.
fields.delivery.preview_fingerprint: Binds approval to the exact server-derived message already reviewed; never supplies message content.
fields.delivery.approval_key: Identifies one explicit approval command for exact-command reconciliation.
fields.delivery.approve: Records a deliberate approval of the exact recipient and message for one transport attempt.

server_only.selected_identity: Bounded issuer/subject/contact tuple in authenticated server form state; never a hidden input.
server_only.intent: Immutable command key, input and base version in authenticated server form state.

controls.find: Looks up one sign-in from the entered email without preparing a conversation.
controls.confirm: Confirms the selected existing sign-in after fresh validation.
controls.reject: Clears the sign-in selection without changing a conversation.
controls.prepare: Prepares the explicitly confirmed conversation, or retries the frozen request.
controls.retry: Confirms or exactly retries the retained immutable command.
controls.review: Reads the latest authorized conversation alongside retained entries.
controls.apply: Reviews an explicit new intent only after a definitive previous result.
controls.discard: Discards local entries, never an unresolved domain command.
controls.acknowledge: Acknowledges a definitive result to release this session guard without changing the conversation.
controls.edit: Returns an unsubmitted review to editable entries without a domain command.
controls.expired_continue: Explicitly releases this session guard after request expiry without determining or replaying its outcome.
controls.authorize_delivery: Authorizes one reviewed delivery attempt; never means participant acceptance or confirmed delivery.

system_inputs.fixed.optional: Every participant action remains optional; the coordinator cannot change this value.
